_comment: Gmail — app password. Host is auto-detected from the domain.
Custom .xyz domain on a generic IMAP host with basic auth. Provide imapHost (and imapPort if not 993).

Outlook / personal Microsoft — read via Microsoft Graph (OAuth2 Mail.Read). Auto-detected: transport=graph. Register an Azure app, add the Graph Mail.Read delegated permission, then run: CLIENT_ID=<id> TENANT=common npm run outlook-auth  to get the refreshToken. See README 'Outlook setup'.
Outlook shortcut for testing: paste a raw access token instead of refresh creds (expires in ~1h).
